input_fields.name: actual_view
input_fields.description: One captured actual view with camera/projection context and image identity.

input_fields.name: reference_view
input_fields.description: One corresponding reference view with comparable camera/projection context and image identity.

input_fields.name: feature_to_check
input_fields.description: One feature or visual claim to compare.

result_fields.name: visual_comparison_record
result_fields.description: One-view agreement, differences, indeterminate items, image regions, and projection caveats.

procedure: Confirm actual_view and reference_view identity, camera/projection, scale, and orientation before comparison.
Inspect feature_to_check in the corresponding image region only; record agreement, difference, or indeterminate.
Bind each observation to image coordinates/regions and retain projection caveats.
Return visual_comparison_record without converting a screenshot into dimensional, topological, save, or reopen evidence.
rejection_rules: Reject noncomparable projections, missing image identity/region, hidden feature, or an attempted whole-model conclusion from one view.
Do not treat absent visibility as structural absence; use VI-21 for unresolved occlusion.
Do not edit the model to improve visual agreement.
